Welcome/start page: Dbdesigner.id title, Recent / Help / New Feature / News link lists

evidence.note: Persistent ribbon frame with tabs, command groups and account identity at top-right

FILE trigger (blue). Live: opens a left full-height backstage panel (New/Open/Properties/Account/Logout + Open project list with search) over a grey scrim; not visible in the capture

patterns.rationale: The content area is a start page shown when no diagram is loaded (live load shows 'Data not found' toast); it acts as a zero state with recents/help, but could equally be read as a plain welcome/home page.

evidence.note: Start screen in place of the diagram canvas, with recents, help links and news

structure.layout: desktop-style app: Office-ribbon header (file/home/edit/account tabs over grouped icon commands) above a grey content area holding a start page with a title and a two-column set of link lists

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (Ant Design system stack, renders as a Helvetica/Arial-like sans) for ribbon labels and link lists; Segoe UI (falls back to Open Sans-like) for the Dbdesigner.id title (30px) and tagline (24px light)
aesthetics.typeScale: 30px/400 title, 24px/300 tagline, 20px section labels, 14px links, 11px ribbon labels, 10px ribbon group captions; low weight contrast throughout

notes: Directly mimics the Microsoft Office ribbon: blue FILE tab (#0072c6) opening a backstage panel, active HOME tab, large icon+label buttons grouped under grey caption strips (Table, Export, Page, Feedback), and compact Page group with width/height/zoom readouts (700 px, 1500 px, 100 %). Start page is bare: title + emoji tagline, then four link lists in two columns of Ant-blue (#1890ff) links. Typos left in copy ('repot', 'Inroduction'). No ribbon/toolbar entry exists in the codebook; ribbon is coded under app-shell + tabs.
